name: Example Rail Operations
hero: Did a defect candidate become the correct, authorized maintenance task on the intended rail asset?
action: Recommend and submit a maintenance work request from an inspection alert
authority: Human-reviewed inspection plus task and segment-specific planner authorization
nativeEffect: CMMS work-request status only; field repair and return-to-service NOT ESTABLISHED
impact: Wrong-segment dispatch or treating an inspection alert as completed repair

riskCases.name: Wrong track segment
riskCases.question: Does the dispatch target match the verified defect-location asset?
riskCases.needed: Geometry / milepost asset map + accepted work-order target

riskCases.name: Machine alert mistaken for confirmed defect
riskCases.question: Was the camera/inspection inference validated by a qualified reviewer?
riskCases.needed: Raw observation, review provenance and approved defect disposition

riskCases.name: Ticket mistaken for repair
riskCases.question: Does an accepted maintenance request prove the work was performed?
riskCases.needed: Crew execution logs + return-to-service approval + independent condition readback

sourceFamilies: CMMS work request and crew approval
controls: A02 · Code capability vs delegated action
limitations: No physical railway dispatch, signal or track control is implemented.
A CMMS request is not a performed repair, cleared restriction or safe-to-operate verdict.
Example Rail Operations is fictional and unrelated to any named rail operator.
